tools.name: get_service_info
tools.description: Start here to discover Scorekeeper's MCP/OAuth and guest REST onboarding, supported scoreboard operations, free limits, current prices and payment steps. Public; no account or authentication needed. Does not create anything.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Read only the connected account's current plan, expiry, board capacity and permissions. Call before offering a paid upgrade. Requires explicit billing:read permission; returns no personal or payment details.

tools.name: create_checkout
tools.description: Create a private Stripe checkout for a current offer after the user expresses purchase intent. Explain price, duration and annual renewal before proceeding. This tool does not charge a card: give checkoutUrl privately to the buyer for payment authorization. Reuse the exact requestId/input after unce

tools.name: get_checkout
tools.description: Read the connected account's checkout by its returned opaque id. Only fulfillmentStatus=fulfilled confirms webhook-granted access; paid/completed alone is insufficient. Poll no more often than every 15 seconds. Return to the requested scoreboard task once access is granted.

tools.name: create_payment_order
tools.description: Prepare an owner-bound one-time payment order after purchase intent, only when get_service_info pricing.paymentMethods.stripe_cli_pay.available is true. Returns the exact @scorekeeper recipient, USD amount and unique memo for stripe pay. Supports pro_week, pro and studio (1–12 calendar months), neve

tools.name: get_payment_order
tools.description: Check only the connected account's payment order and reconcile a bank receipt. May activate access after matching verified received funds. Only fulfillmentStatus=fulfilled confirms access; CLI output or sender status does not. Poll no more often than pollAfterSeconds (at least 60 seconds). Bank tran

tools.name: create_scoreboard
tools.description: Create a public, shareable two-team scoreboard at zero. Requires explicit user intent to create; title and team names are public. Works without signing in: the result then includes a private claim.url (valid up to seven days) for the person who will keep score; it lets them score in the browser and

tools.name: get_scoreboard
tools.description: Read a scoreboard created through this API by the connected account, including stable team IDs and current revision.

tools.name: list_scoreboards
tools.description: List the connected account's API-created generic scoreboards. Does not list unrelated legacy boards. Pass nextCursor as cursor to continue until null; a filtered page can be empty.

tools.name: update_scoreboard
tools.description: Atomically set exact scores, increment scores, rename teams or change title. Use stable team IDs and the last read revision. Updates immediately appear publicly. On revision_conflict read the board and decide again; do not blindly replay a stale increment. Identical retry IDs return the previous res

tools.name: hand_off_scoreboard
tools.description: Return the connected account owner’s private management link. Share it only with the intended scorer, never spectators. Does not transfer ownership. Reuse requestId on retry.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "create_scoreboard" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
